synthetic.coding: Categorical factors; sum-to-zero contrasts. Complete balanced observed grid.
synthetic.families: ANOVA: nominal p; factorial marginal effects: Holm over 3; planned dataset contrasts: Holm over 4; method comparisons: Holm over 12. Separate families within each training analysis.
synthetic.inference: ANOVA/model intervals assume independent homoskedastic residuals and are exploratory. Shared heldout rows and dataset-specific treatment effects limit those assumptions. Dataset paired inference uses 5 task means, not 120 independent tasks.
synthetic.removed: No combined treatment factor or random-intercept mixed model. No repeated-measures appendix.
synthetic.seed: 42 and 43 are categorical fixed levels. Seed interactions compare these two runs, not a population of possible seeds.
